Industrial Control.reason_en: Apache PLC4X OPC UA driver improperly verifies cryptographic signatures, enabling network impersonation and secure-channel traffic forgery.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: Apache PLC4X OPC UA 驱动程序未能正确验证加密签名，可实现网络身份冒充和安全通道流量伪造。

Industrial Control.reason: Codesys monitoring functionality lacks proper synchronization, allowing authenticated attackers to corrupt internal memory structures during concurrent access.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Codesys monitoring functionality lacks proper synchronization, allowing authenticated attackers to corrupt internal memory structures during concurrent access.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: Codesys 监控功能缺乏适当的同步机制，允许已认证攻击者在并发访问期间破坏内部内存结构。

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated RCE in Balbooa Forms for Joomla occurs via field shortcode injection, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary PHP code after form submissions.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated RCE in Balbooa Forms for Joomla occurs via field shortcode injection, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary PHP code after form submissions.
Web Security.reason_zh: Joomla 插件 Balbooa Forms 存在未认证远程代码执行漏洞，攻击者可通过字段短代码注入，在表单提交后执行任意 PHP 代码。

Web Security.reason: Stored XSS in Kiteworks Core enables unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute in administrators' sessions upon viewing compromised content.
Web Security.reason_en: Stored XSS in Kiteworks Core enables unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute in administrators' sessions upon viewing compromised content.
Web Security.reason_zh: Kiteworks Core 存在存储型 XSS 漏洞，未认证攻击者可注入恶意脚本，管理员查看被篡改内容时将在其会话中执行这些脚本。

Web Security.reason: Stored XSS in Grav CMS Data Manager plugin renders user-controlled content without proper escaping, facilitating session hijacking or defacement attacks.
Web Security.reason_en: Stored XSS in Grav CMS Data Manager plugin renders user-controlled content without proper escaping, facilitating session hijacking or defacement attacks.
Web Security.reason_zh: Grav CMS Data Manager 插件存在存储型 XSS 漏洞，渲染用户可控内容时未进行适当转义，易导致会话劫持或网站篡改攻击。

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated server-side request forgery in Kiteworks Secure Data Forms enables attackers to probe internal networks and exfiltrate responses from restricted services.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated server-side request forgery in Kiteworks Secure Data Forms enables attackers to probe internal networks and exfiltrate responses from restricted services.
Web Security.reason_zh: Kiteworks Secure Data Forms 存在未认证的服务端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞，使攻击者能够探测内网并从受限服务中窃取响应数据。

Web Security.reason: Stored SQL injection in administrative reporting features allows authenticated users to dump underlying database contents and disrupt service availability.
Web Security.reason_en: Stored SQL injection in administrative reporting features allows authenticated users to dump underlying database contents and disrupt service availability.
Web Security.reason_zh: 管理报表功能中存在存储型 SQL 注入漏洞，允许已认证用户导出底层数据库内容并破坏服务可用性。

Web Security.reason: Exposed RPyC service with pickle deserialization in LightLLM allows unauthenticated remote code execution via crafted inference requests targeting AI model deployments.
Web Security.reason_en: Exposed RPyC service with pickle deserialization in LightLLM allows unauthenticated remote code execution via crafted inference requests targeting AI model deployments.
Web Security.reason_zh: LightLLM 中暴露的带有 pickle 反序列化的 RPyC 服务，允许通过针对 AI 模型部署的精心构造的推理请求实现未认证的远程代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Default configuration exposes Yii debug and Gii modules to all IP addresses, granting unauthenticated attackers access to sensitive sessions, database queries, and code execution.
Web Security.reason_en: Default configuration exposes Yii debug and Gii modules to all IP addresses, granting unauthenticated attackers access to sensitive sessions, database queries, and code execution.
Web Security.reason_zh: 默认配置将 Yii 的 debug 和 Gii 模块暴露给所有 IP 地址，使未认证攻击者能够访问敏感会话、数据库查询并执行代码。

Web Security.reason: Unescaped action parameters in CrowdStrike integration scripts allow authenticated users to inject and execute arbitrary system commands within security orchestration platforms.
Web Security.reason_en: Unescaped action parameters in CrowdStrike integration scripts allow authenticated users to inject and execute arbitrary system commands within security orchestration platforms.
Web Security.reason_zh: CrowdStrike 集成脚本中的动作参数未进行转义，允许已认证用户在安全编排平台中注入并执行任意系统命令。

Web Security.reason: Authentication bypass in cPanel and WHM login flows allows unauthenticated remote attackers to gain unauthorized administrative access to control panels.
Web Security.reason_en: Authentication bypass in cPanel and WHM login flows allows unauthenticated remote attackers to gain unauthorized administrative access to control panels.
Web Security.reason_zh: cPanel 和 WHM 登录流程存在身份验证绕过漏洞，使未认证远程攻击者能够未经授权获取控制面板的管理员访问权限。

Web Security.reason: Hardcoded static master login verification code in X-SpringBoot enables unauthenticated attackers to authenticate as any user using known contact details.
Web Security.reason_en: Hardcoded static master login verification code in X-SpringBoot enables unauthenticated attackers to authenticate as any user using known contact details.
Web Security.reason_zh: X-SpringBoot 中硬编码的静态主登录验证码，使未认证攻击者能够利用已知联系方式冒充任何用户进行身份验证。

Web Security.reason: Lack of file type validation in yii2-starter-kit's backend storage upload allows authenticated managers to upload and execute arbitrary PHP scripts on the server.
Web Security.reason_en: Lack of file type validation in yii2-starter-kit's backend storage upload allows authenticated managers to upload and execute arbitrary PHP scripts on the server.
Web Security.reason_zh: yii2-starter-kit 后端存储上传功能缺乏文件类型验证，允许已认证的管理员在服务器上上传并执行任意 PHP 脚本。

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated remote code execution in OrdaSoft Joomla CCK via an unprotected uploader endpoint allows complete website compromise.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated remote code execution in OrdaSoft Joomla CCK via an unprotected uploader endpoint allows complete website compromise.
Web Security.reason_zh: OrdaSoft Joomla CCK 通过未受保护的上传器端点存在未认证远程代码执行漏洞，可导致网站完全沦陷。

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated PHP object injection in ILIAS e-learning platform triggers deserialization via Shibboleth, granting full remote code execution capabilities.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated PHP object injection in ILIAS e-learning platform triggers deserialization via Shibboleth, granting full remote code execution capabilities.
Web Security.reason_zh: ILIAS 电子学习平台存在未认证的 PHP 对象注入漏洞，通过 Shibboleth 触发反序列化，赋予完整的远程代码执行能力。

Web Security.reason: Premature issuance of rememberme cookies in Joomla bypasses Multi-Factor Authentication, allowing unauthorized persistent access to user accounts.
Web Security.reason_en: Premature issuance of rememberme cookies in Joomla bypasses Multi-Factor Authentication, allowing unauthorized persistent access to user accounts.
Web Security.reason_zh: Joomla 中过早颁发 rememberme Cookie 可绕过多因素认证，使未经授权的攻击者能够持久访问用户账户。

Web Security.reason: Insecure deserialization in EasyFlow .NET facilitates arbitrary code execution via unauthenticated requests, compromising web application servers.
Web Security.reason_en: Insecure deserialization in EasyFlow .NET facilitates arbitrary code execution via unauthenticated requests, compromising web application servers.
Web Security.reason_zh: EasyFlow .NET 中存在不安全反序列化漏洞，攻击者可通过未认证请求实现任意代码执行，从而导致 Web 应用服务器被攻陷。

Web Security.reason: Blind SQL injection in a widely deployed WordPress plugin exposes numerous sites to database exfiltration and potential server compromise.
Web Security.reason_en: Blind SQL injection in a widely deployed WordPress plugin exposes numerous sites to database exfiltration and potential server compromise.
Web Security.reason_zh: 一款广泛部署的 WordPress 插件存在盲 SQL 注入漏洞，致使大量网站面临数据库数据窃取及服务器被控的风险。

Web Security.reason: JWT token misconfiguration in Sylius allows shop customers to obtain administrator tokens, leading to complete platform takeover.
Web Security.reason_en: JWT token misconfiguration in Sylius allows shop customers to obtain administrator tokens, leading to complete platform takeover.
Web Security.reason_zh: Sylius 中的 JWT 令牌配置不当允许商店客户获取管理员令牌，进而导致平台被完全接管。

Web Security.reason: External control of file paths in .NET allows attackers to escalate privileges over a network, compromising web application integrity.
Web Security.reason_en: External control of file paths in .NET allows attackers to escalate privileges over a network, compromising web application integrity.
Web Security.reason_zh: .NET 中的文件路径外部控制漏洞允许攻击者通过网络提升权限，从而破坏 Web 应用的完整性。

Web Security.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in the .NET runtime and Visual Studio enables privilege escalation over a network, affecting web deployment pipelines.
Web Security.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the .NET runtime and Visual Studio enables privilege escalation over a network, affecting web deployment pipelines.
Web Security.reason_zh: .NET 运行时和 Visual Studio 中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可实现在线提权，影响 Web 部署流水线。

Web Security.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office allows remote code execution via malicious files commonly distributed through phishing campaigns.
Web Security.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office allows remote code execution via malicious files commonly distributed through phishing campaigns.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Office 中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，攻击者可通过钓鱼活动常见的恶意文件实现远程代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Improper access control in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables network-based privilege escalation, exposing enterprise collaboration platforms to unauthorized administrative actions.
Web Security.reason_en: Improper access control in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables network-based privilege escalation, exposing enterprise collaboration platforms to unauthorized administrative actions.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中存在访问控制不当漏洞，可导致基于网络的提权，使企业协作平台面临未授权管理操作的风险。

Web Security.reason: Broken access control in AzuraCast allows authenticated view-only users to extract Icecast/Shoutcast credentials, compromising media streaming infrastructure.
Web Security.reason_en: Broken access control in AzuraCast allows authenticated view-only users to extract Icecast/Shoutcast credentials, compromising media streaming infrastructure.
Web Security.reason_zh: AzuraCast 中存在访问控制失效漏洞，允许已认证的仅查看权限用户提取 Icecast/Shoutcast 凭据，从而破坏媒体流基础设施。

Web Security.reason: Improper access control in SharePoint permits network-based privilege escalation, indicating systemic authorization flaws in web application deployments.
Web Security.reason_en: Improper access control in SharePoint permits network-based privilege escalation, indicating systemic authorization flaws in web application deployments.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint 中存在访问控制不当漏洞，允许基于网络的提权，反映出 Web 应用部署中存在系统性的授权缺陷。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Exchange Server enables remote spoofing and credential theft. As a globally deployed email platform, this flaw carries a massive organizational blast radius.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Exchange Server enables remote spoofing and credential theft. As a globally deployed email platform, this flaw carries a massive organizational blast radius.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中存在跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，可实现远程伪造与凭证窃取。作为全球部署的邮件平台，该漏洞具有极大的组织级影响范围。

Web Security.reason: SQL injection in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows privilege escalation over the network. This directly threatens enterprise content management and collaborative web applications.
Web Security.reason_en: SQL injection in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows privilege escalation over the network. This directly threatens enterprise content management and collaborative web applications.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中存在 SQL 注入漏洞，允许通过网络提权，直接威胁企业内容管理与协作式 Web 应用的安全。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 8.5 Joomla Modules Anywhere LFI/SSRF allows attackers to read local files or forge server-side requests via manipulated module attributes.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 8.5 Joomla Modules Anywhere LFI/SSRF allows attackers to read local files or forge server-side requests via manipulated module attributes.
Web Security.reason_zh: CVSS 8.5 的 Joomla Modules Anywhere LFI/SSRF 漏洞允许攻击者通过篡改模块属性读取本地文件或伪造服务端请求。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 9.3 Unauthenticated SQL injection in Joomla Book Library bypasses weak filtering, enabling complete database extraction.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 9.3 Unauthenticated SQL injection in Joomla Book Library bypasses weak filtering, enabling complete database extraction.
Web Security.reason_zh: CVSS 9.3 的 Joomla Book Library 未认证 SQL 注入漏洞绕过了弱过滤机制，可实现完整的数据库提取。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 9.3 Unauthenticated SQL injection in Joomla Real Estate Manager constructs malicious ORDER BY clauses to query backend databases.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 9.3 Unauthenticated SQL injection in Joomla Real Estate Manager constructs malicious ORDER BY clauses to query backend databases.
Web Security.reason_zh: CVSS 9.3 的 Joomla Real Estate Manager 未认证 SQL 注入漏洞可构造恶意的 ORDER BY 子句以查询后端数据库。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 9.3 Unauthenticated SQL injection in Joomla Vehicle Manager exposes databases to injection attacks through unsanitized sort parameters.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 9.3 Unauthenticated SQL injection in Joomla Vehicle Manager exposes databases to injection attacks through unsanitized sort parameters.
Web Security.reason_zh: CVSS 9.3 的 Joomla Vehicle Manager 未认证 SQL 注入漏洞通过未过滤的排序参数使数据库暴露于注入攻击之下。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 7.5 Hugo symlink traversal exploits Node.js permission model limitations to escape project directories and read sensitive files.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 Hugo symlink traversal exploits Node.js permission model limitations to escape project directories and read sensitive files.
Web Security.reason_zh: CVSS 7.5 的 Hugo 符号链接遍历漏洞利用了 Node.js 权限模型的缺陷，使攻击者能够逃逸项目目录并读取敏感文件。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 8.8 Grav CMS blueprint access map flaw allows privilege escalation by bypassing security guards through flat dot-notation keys.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 Grav CMS blueprint access map flaw allows privilege escalation by bypassing security guards through flat dot-notation keys.
Web Security.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8 的 Grav CMS 蓝图访问映射缺陷允许攻击者通过扁平的点表示法键值绕过安全守卫机制，从而实现提权。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 7.1 LimeSurvey IDOR in survey patching endpoints fails to validate context ownership, enabling cross-user data manipulation.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 7.1 LimeSurvey IDOR in survey patching endpoints fails to validate context ownership, enabling cross-user data manipulation.
Web Security.reason_zh: CVSS 7.1 的 LimeSurvey 问卷修补端点存在 IDOR 漏洞，因未能验证上下文所有权，导致可实施跨用户数据篡改。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 8.1 SiYuan Note authentication guard fails open when Origin headers are absent, granting unauthorized administrator access.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 SiYuan Note authentication guard fails open when Origin headers are absent, granting unauthorized administrator access.
Web Security.reason_zh: CVSS 8.1 的 SiYuan Note 在缺少 Origin 头时认证守卫会默认放行，从而授予未授权的管理员访问权限。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 7.6 SiYuan Note CSRF vulnerability forces administrative actions on victims by bypassing origin validation on loopback requests.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 7.6 SiYuan Note CSRF vulnerability forces administrative actions on victims by bypassing origin validation on loopback requests.
Web Security.reason_zh: CVSS 7.6 的 SiYuan Note CSRF 漏洞通过绕过回环请求的源验证，强制受害者执行管理操作。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 9.8 Unauthenticated UNION-based SQL injection in Fumasoft Cloud Ajax endpoints enables complete database compromise.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 Unauthenticated UNION-based SQL injection in Fumasoft Cloud Ajax endpoints enables complete database compromise.
Web Security.reason_zh: CVSS 9.8 的 Fumasoft Cloud Ajax 端点存在未认证的基于 UNION 的 SQL 注入漏洞，可导致数据库被完全攻陷。

Web Security.reason: SiteSkite plugin allows unauthenticated remote code execution with a CVSS of 10.0, posing a critical threat to WordPress deployments.
Web Security.reason_en: SiteSkite plugin allows unauthenticated remote code execution with a CVSS of 10.0, posing a critical threat to WordPress deployments.
Web Security.reason_zh: SiteSkite 插件存在 CVSS 10.0 的未认证远程代码执行漏洞，对 WordPress 部署构成严重威胁。

Web Security.reason: CartFlows plugin contains contributor-level remote code execution, enabling lower-privileged users to compromise entire websites.
Web Security.reason_en: CartFlows plugin contains contributor-level remote code execution, enabling lower-privileged users to compromise entire websites.
Web Security.reason_zh: CartFlows 插件存在贡献者级别的远程代码执行漏洞，使低权限用户能够攻陷整个网站。

Web Security.reason: OAuth Single Sign On plugin suffers from an unauthenticated bypass vulnerability, undermining identity verification mechanisms.
Web Security.reason_en: OAuth Single Sign On plugin suffers from an unauthenticated bypass vulnerability, undermining identity verification mechanisms.
Web Security.reason_zh: OAuth Single Sign On 插件存在未认证绕过漏洞，破坏了身份验证机制。

Web Security.reason: Booking Activities plugin exposes unauthenticated PHP object injection, allowing attackers to achieve remote code execution.
Web Security.reason_en: Booking Activities plugin exposes unauthenticated PHP object injection, allowing attackers to achieve remote code execution.
Web Security.reason_zh: Booking Activities 插件暴露了未认证的 PHP 对象注入漏洞，允许攻击者实现远程代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Estatik plugin allows subscriber privilege escalation, granting unauthorized administrative control over property listings.
Web Security.reason_en: Estatik plugin allows subscriber privilege escalation, granting unauthorized administrative control over property listings.
Web Security.reason_zh: Estatik 插件允许订阅者提权，从而获得对房源信息的未授权管理控制权。

Web Security.reason: Books Gallery plugin contains unauthenticated SQL injection, risking full database compromise and sensitive data exfiltration.
Web Security.reason_en: Books Gallery plugin contains unauthenticated SQL injection, risking full database compromise and sensitive data exfiltration.
Web Security.reason_zh: Books Gallery 插件存在未认证的 SQL 注入漏洞，可能导致数据库完全被攻陷及敏感数据外泄。

Web Security.reason: 10Web Booster plugin suffers from contributor-level PHP object injection, enabling code execution on affected WordPress installations.
Web Security.reason_en: 10Web Booster plugin suffers from contributor-level PHP object injection, enabling code execution on affected WordPress installations.
Web Security.reason_zh: 10Web Booster 插件存在贡献者级别的 PHP 对象注入漏洞，可在受影响的 WordPress 环境中实现代码执行。

Web Security.reason: MakeCommerce for WooCommerce allows subscriber broken access control, permitting unauthorized modifications to payment configurations.
Web Security.reason_en: MakeCommerce for WooCommerce allows subscriber broken access control, permitting unauthorized modifications to payment configurations.
Web Security.reason_zh: MakeCommerce for WooCommerce 存在订阅者级别的访问控制失效漏洞，允许未授权修改支付配置。

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated RCE in a widely deployed WordPress newsletter plugin allows attackers to fully compromise web servers without prior credentials. Its high exploitability and prevalence make it a prime target for automated botnets.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated RCE in a widely deployed WordPress newsletter plugin allows attackers to fully compromise web servers without prior credentials. Its high exploitability and prevalence make it a prime target for automated botnets.
Web Security.reason_zh: 一款广泛部署的 WordPress 新闻通讯插件存在未认证 RCE 漏洞，攻击者无需凭证即可完全攻陷 Web 服务器。其高可利用性与广泛分布使其成为自动化僵尸网络的首要目标。

Web Security.reason: Critical CSRF flaw in a popular WooCommerce anti-fraud extension enables session hijacking and unauthorized checkout manipulations. Attackers can leverage this to bypass fraud checks and steal customer data or revenue.
Web Security.reason_en: Critical CSRF flaw in a popular WooCommerce anti-fraud extension enables session hijacking and unauthorized checkout manipulations. Attackers can leverage this to bypass fraud checks and steal customer data or revenue.
Web Security.reason_zh: WooCommerce 流行反欺诈扩展程序中的严重 CSRF 漏洞可导致会话劫持和未授权的结账操作篡改。攻击者可利用此漏洞绕过欺诈检查，窃取客户数据或收益。

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated SQL injection in a community engagement plugin permits attackers to extract sensitive user databases and escalate to administrative privileges. The lack of authentication requirement significantly lowers the barrier for exploitation.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated SQL injection in a community engagement plugin permits attackers to extract sensitive user databases and escalate to administrative privileges. The lack of authentication requirement significantly lowers the barrier for exploitation.
Web Security.reason_zh: 社区互动插件中存在未认证的 SQL 注入漏洞，允许攻击者提取敏感用户数据库并提权至管理员级别。无需认证的要求显著降低了利用门槛。

Web Security.reason: Stored XSS in MISP event graph previews compromises threat intelligence analysts by executing malicious scripts directly in their browsers. This undermines trust in collaborative security platforms and risks credential theft.
Web Security.reason_en: Stored XSS in MISP event graph previews compromises threat intelligence analysts by executing malicious scripts directly in their browsers. This undermines trust in collaborative security platforms and risks credential theft.
Web Security.reason_zh: MISP 事件图预览中的存储型 XSS 漏洞会在分析师浏览器中直接执行恶意脚本，从而危及威胁情报分析师的安全。此举破坏了协作安全平台的信任基础，并存在凭证被盗风险。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Flawed TLS context handling in Python allows unauthenticated clients to trigger crashes or use-after-free conditions, impacting middleware relying on standard SSL libraries.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Flawed TLS context handling in Python allows unauthenticated clients to trigger crashes or use-after-free conditions, impacting middleware relying on standard SSL libraries.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Python 中缺陷的 TLS 上下文处理机制允许未认证客户端触发崩溃或释放后使用（UAF）漏洞，影响依赖标准 SSL 库的中间件。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Unauthenticated access control bypass in Red Hat PCP's pmproxy allows metric overwrites that can escalate to arbitrary code execution on monitoring servers.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Unauthenticated access control bypass in Red Hat PCP's pmproxy allows metric overwrites that can escalate to arbitrary code execution on monitoring servers.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Red Hat PCP 的 pmproxy 中存在未认证的访问控制绕过漏洞，允许覆盖指标数据，进而可能在监控服务器上导致任意代码执行。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Inadequate unsafe operation blocking in simple-git allows attacker-controlled git commands to execute within Node.js applications, risking source code manipulation.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Inadequate unsafe operation blocking in simple-git allows attacker-controlled git commands to execute within Node.js applications, risking source code manipulation.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: simple-git 对不安全操作的拦截不足，允许攻击者控制的 git 命令在 Node.js 应用中执行，可能导致源代码被篡改。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Stack-based buffer overflow in Pgpool-II can be triggered by unauthenticated attackers to crash the database proxy, severely impacting query routing and availability.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Pgpool-II can be triggered by unauthenticated attackers to crash the database proxy, severely impacting query routing and availability.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Pgpool-II 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可被未认证攻击者触发，导致数据库代理崩溃，严重影响查询路由和服务可用性。

Databases & Middleware.reason: SQL injection in PostgreSQL extension scripts allows attackers with data access to execute privileged commands if vulnerable third-party extensions are installed.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: SQL injection in PostgreSQL extension scripts allows attackers with data access to execute privileged commands if vulnerable third-party extensions are installed.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: 若安装了存在漏洞的第三方扩展，PostgreSQL 扩展脚本中的 SQL 注入漏洞可使具备数据访问权限的攻击者执行特权命令。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Pre-authentication SSRF in Adminer's ClickHouse driver plugin allows unauthenticated attackers to forge requests to arbitrary internal servers, exposing backend infrastructure.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Pre-authentication SSRF in Adminer's ClickHouse driver plugin allows unauthenticated attackers to forge requests to arbitrary internal servers, exposing backend infrastructure.

summary: Today's vulnerability report reveals a critical concentration of remote code execution and authentication bypass flaws within desktop operating systems, web applications, and cloud services, where memory corruption and improper input validation remain prevalent attack vectors. High-impact issues affect major vendors including Microsoft, NVIDIA, and Cisco, compromising core infrastructure through kernel exploits in GPU drivers, identity management failures in Active Directory, and configuration weaknesses in SD-WAN and database proxies. Additionally, significant risks persist in IoT and industrial control ecosystems due to hardcoded credentials and firmware tampering capabilities, while emerging threats in AI frameworks and middleware demonstrate escalating dangers related to deserialization attacks and sandbox escapes.
